table.retrieve:
SELECT
	transtype='S', 
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end, 
	users.username, 
	salecat=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	altersaleinvcode=max(saleledger.altersaleinvcode),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	dbo.saledetail.gcode, 
	cashreceived=max(dbo.saleledger.cashreceived),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(saleledger.machinename),
	invtotal = saleledger.invtotal,
	srinvtotal = 0
	
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,
	item,
	Users 
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )

GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks, 
	saledetail.icode, 
	saledetail.rowgroup,
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.customicode,
	users.username,
	saleledger.invtotal
UNION ALL
SELECT
	transtype='R',
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end, 
	users.username, 
	salecat=max(srl.srcatcode),
	srl.custcode,
	headerno = srl.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=srl.custcode),
	altersaleinvcode=srl.srbufferinvcode,
	saleinvcode=srl.srbufferinvcode, 
	srl.date,   
	srl.discperc,   
	srl.misccharges,   
	srl.flatdisc,   
	srl.salestax,   
	srl.custcode,   
	srl.remarks,   
	srd.icode,   
	srd.gcode, 
	cashreceived=max(sl.cashreceived),
	Id        = MAX(srd.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(srd.looseqty), 
	packqty   = 0, 
	packunits = max(srd.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(srd.srprice), 
	rate      = max(srd.srprice),
	salestax  = max(srd.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(srd.discperc), 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = 0,
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(srl.machinename),
	invtotal = 0,
	srinvtotal = srl.invtotal
	
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger sl, 
	dbo.srbufferledger srl,   
	dbo.srbufferdetail srd,  
	item,
	Users 
	
WHERE 
	( sl.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( srl.srbufferinvcode = sl.srbufferinvcode ) AND
	( srl.srbufferinvcode = srd.srbufferinvcode ) AND 
	( srl.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( srd.icode = item.icode )

GROUP BY 
	srl.srbufferinvcode, 
	srl.date, 
	srl.custcode, 
	srl.discperc, 
	srl.flatdisc, 
	srl.misccharges, 
	srl.headerno,
	srl.salestax, 
	srl.remarks, 
	srd.icode, 
	srd.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.customicode,
	users.username,
	srl.invtotal

ORDER BY 
	transtype, id
